mapper.sql: id,tenant_id AS tenantId,corp_id AS corpId,recall_message_id AS recallMessageId,original_message_id AS originalMessageId,recall_seq AS recallSeq,external_userid AS externalUserid,staff_user_id AS staffUserId,sender_type AS senderType,occurred_at AS occurredAt,status,original_message_ref AS originalMessageRef,created_at AS createdAt,applied_at AS appliedAt,version,conversation_type AS conversationType,conversation_id AS conversationId,sender_wecom_userid AS senderWecomUserid
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_wecom_recall_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND corp_id=#{corpId} AND recall_message_id=#{recallMessageId}
SELECT FROM crm_wecom_recall_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND corp_id=#{corpId} AND original_message_id=#{originalMessageId} AND status='PENDING_ORIGINAL'
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_wecom_recall_event SET status='APPLIED',original_message_ref=#{originalMessageRef},applied_at=#{appliedAt},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING_ORIGINAL'
